opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. Motion of Anti-Defamation League of B’nai B’rith et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of respondent Michael David Remer for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari granted and case set for oral argument in tandem with No. 85-2169, St. Francis College v. Al-Khazraji, immediately infra.
